archetype: ORGANIC & HIGH-CONTRAST EDITORIAL (Saliend-Inspired Forest Dark + Soft Mint)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]

sections.name: Floating Glass Header
sections.description: Sticky backdrop-blur navigation with brand logo, live Solana mainnet status pill, doc link, and Open App CTA button.

sections.name: Editorial Hero with Isometric ZK Cloak Wireframe
sections.description: Massive headline ('Disappear from the ledger.'), subheadline explaining Solana ZK shield pool, real-time stats ticker, primary action button ('Enter Privacy Pool'), and an interactive isometric SVG wireframe of a cloaked token passing through a Groth16 proof prism.

sections.name: Live Anonymity Pool Stats Bar
sections.description: Real-time dynamic stat ticker showing total pool TVL, sealed notes count, nullifiers generated, and average proof generation time (~1.2s). Auto-updates every 5 seconds with soft mint flash animation.

sections.name: 01/02/03 Numbered Protocol Flow
sections.description: Three sequential steps in Saliend's numbered row style: 01. Shield (Cloak tokens into zero-knowledge pool), 02. Private Move (Transact & swap via off-chain nullifiers), 03. Uncloak Anywhere (Exit to clean fresh addresses or cross-chain routes).

sections.name: Groth16 & Poseidon ZK Privacy Architecture
sections.description: Deep-dive interactive technical grid explaining Groth16/BN254 zk-SNARK proof verification, Poseidon hash Merkle Tree depth 20, and single-use cryptographic nullifiers preventing double-spending while masking all addresses.

sections.name: Solana Alpenglow Era 150ms Finality
sections.description: Dedicated feature section spotlighting Solana's new Alpenglow consensus engine integration, providing instantaneous ~150ms ZK proof submission and instant transaction finality.

sections.name: Honest Fee Model & Decentralized Relayers
sections.description: Transparent breakdown of the 0.3% protocol fee + gas-free decentralized relayer mesh that pays target gas fees on behalf of uncloaking addresses.

sections.name: Final Launch Cloak Protocol Banner
sections.description: High-impact conversion box with ambient mint glow, 'Shield your first asset now' CTA, and quick link to developer documentation.

sections.name: Quiet Architectural Footer
sections.description: Minimalist dark footer with version tag, Solana network indicator, system status, and links to docs, GitHub, and terms.

hero_prism.style: Isometric 3D line-art with nested diamond polygons and glowing mint laser line
hero_prism.elements: Layered isometric grid, input token arrow, Groth16 proof prism with mint border, unlinked nullifier outputs

merkle_circuit.style: Thin 1px stroke binary Merkle tree with glowing active path and Poseidon hash nodes
merkle_circuit.elements: Tree nodes connected by animated dashed paths leading to root hash zero-knowledge commitment

alpenglow_speed.style: Concentric rings and sub-second pulse radar representing 150ms finality
alpenglow_speed.elements: Speed wave vectors with 150ms timestamp label and Solana gradient stroke

css_keyframes: @keyframes cloakPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1.03); } }
@keyframes floatSlow { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(1deg); } }
motion_and_animations.hover_effects: Card borders transition from rgba(169,231,192,0.12) to rgba(169,231,192,0.4) with slight y-axis lift (-2px). Buttons have smooth backdrop pulse.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all copy reflects 'Cloak Privacy' and Solana ZK privacy pool branding.
Do NOT use external image URLs. Use inline SVG line-art with stroke width 1px to 1.5px and mint (#a9e7c0) accents.
Keep existing endpoints and backend proxies intact in frontend/backend integration.
Verify Google Fonts link for Syne, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono is included in index.html or injected.
Include data-testid attributes on all key buttons, inputs, statistics, and links as defined in layout_structure.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure black #000000; use forest black #080c09 with green tint.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Grid children must be direct children to preserve responsive alignment.
Maintain high APCA contrast with light mint (#a9e7c0) on dark forest backgrounds.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) with subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl / rounded-2xl).
